content_sections.heading: Kerala State Lottery Directorate Junior Programmer Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.state_lotteries_directorate_department_o: B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology or Electronics and Communication Engineering (or equivalent), OR MCA, OR DOEACC 'B' Level or 'C' Level (or equivalent) with Computer Specialisation.

content_sections.heading: Kerala State Lottery Directorate Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. SLTY/5083/2024-IT SD2 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Kerala State Lottery Directorate notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology or Electronics and Communication Engineering, or equivalent; Master of Computer Applications (MCA); DOEACC 'B' Level or 'C' Level with Computer Specialisation, or equivalent Experience: Freshers and those with up to a maximum of two years of experience in software development or allied fields may apply Age limit: Maximum 35 years Other conditions: Candidates must hold the prescribed qualification and experience on the date notified by the department. Desirable: Practical experience in at least one PHP framework; Symfony or Laravel preferred Knowledge of React.js preferred Knowledge of Docker, Nginx/Apache, ORM tools, unit testing, web application security and software deployment is an additional qualification

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Kerala State Lottery Directorate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications sent directly or by e-mail will not be accepted Incomplete applications or those not meeting the prescribed criteria will be rejected

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract engagement for one year Contract period may be extended based on satisfactory performance and departmental requirement

content_sections.heading: How Will Kerala State Lottery Directorate Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written test Interview of shortlisted candidates Final rank list based on marks in written test and interview Written test and the interview that follows it form the basis of selection A shortlist is prepared on the basis of the written test; only shortlisted candidates are called for interview Final rank list is prepared on marks obtained in the written test and interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Detailed biodata/resume Copies of certificates proving educational qualification Copy of photo identity proof Experience certificates Other relevant supporting documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kerala State Lottery Directorate Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply only through the Google Application Form given in the notice. Include a detailed biodata/resume. Include copies of certificates proving educational qualification. Include a copy of a photo identity proof. Include experience certificates and other relevant supporting documents. Apply on or before 12 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted only through the Google Application Form Department may amend, change or cancel the recruitment procedure subject to rules and administrative requirements Further notices will be given through the official channels of the department Holding the prescribed qualifications alone does not confer a right to appointment

faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years.

faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must hold the prescribed qualification and experience on the date notified by the department.

faq.answer: Written test. Interview of shortlisted candidates. Final rank list based on marks in written test and interview. Written test and the interview that follows it form the basis of selection.
